tools.name: generate_exercises
tools.description: Verified maths exercises for tutors, human or AI, in French (Swiss course conventions) or English. Seven topics, six for the first year of maturité: product equations (équations produit) of degree 2 and 3, linear equations (équations du premier degré), quadratic equations (équations du second degré)

tools.name: explain_principle
tools.description: Why a maths principle holds, shown on its figure, for a student who asks why or a tutor preparing an explanation. special-products: the identités remarquables of the first year of maturité, (a + b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2, (a - b)^2 = a^2 - 2ab + b^2 and (a + b)(a - b) = a^2 - b^2, each read on a figure

tools.name: request_exercise
tools.description: Ask Limpide for maths exercises this server does not have yet, or give one line of feedback on an exercise. Use it when generate_exercises has no topic for what the tutor needs. findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "generate_exercises" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
